examples.en: The tallest skyscraper in the city has more than a hundred floors.
examples.zh: 這座城市最高的摩天大樓有一百多層樓。

examples.en: From the top of the skyscraper, we could see the whole harbor.
examples.zh: 從摩天大樓的頂樓，我們可以看到整個港口。

examples.en: My uncle works in an office on the fortieth floor of a skyscraper.
examples.zh: 我叔叔在一棟摩天大樓的四十樓辦公。

examples.en: There is a slight chance of rain this afternoon.
examples.zh: 今天下午下雨的機率很低。

examples.en: I felt a slight pain in my left foot after the game.
examples.zh: 比賽後我覺得左腳有一點痛。

examples.en: She is a slight girl, but she runs very fast.
examples.zh: 她是個身形纖細的女孩，但跑得很快。

examples.en: The company's new slogan is easy to remember.
examples.zh: 公司的新標語很容易記住。

examples.en: Students made posters with a slogan about saving water.
examples.zh: 學生們製作了印有節約用水標語的海報。

examples.en: Our team chose a short slogan for the school sports day.
examples.zh: 我們的隊伍為學校運動會選了一句簡短的口號。

examples.en: There is only one socket in my room, so I need a power strip.
examples.zh: 我的房間只有一個插座，所以需要一條延長線。

examples.en: Please plug the lamp into the socket near the window.
examples.zh: 請把檯燈插進窗邊的插座。

examples.en: The doctor checked whether the bone had moved out of the shoulder socket.
examples.zh: 醫生檢查骨頭是否脫離了肩膀的關節窩。

examples.en: You need to update the software before you can use this app.
examples.zh: 你得先更新軟體才能使用這個應用程式。

examples.en: My brother works for a company that makes educational software.
examples.zh: 我哥哥在一家製作教育軟體的公司工作。

examples.en: The new software saves us a lot of time at the office.
examples.zh: 這套新軟體替我們在辦公室省下不少時間。

examples.en: Our school installed solar panels on the roof last year.
examples.zh: 我們學校去年在屋頂安裝了太陽能板。

examples.en: The solar system has eight planets that orbit the sun.
examples.zh: 太陽系有八顆繞太陽運行的行星。

examples.en: A solar eclipse happens when the moon passes in front of the sun.
examples.zh: 日蝕發生在月亮移到太陽前面的時候。

examples.en: He dug a hole in the garden with a spade.
examples.zh: 他用鏟子在花園裡挖了一個洞。

examples.en: The children brought a bucket and a spade to the beach.
examples.zh: 孩子們帶了一個水桶和一把鏟子去海邊。

examples.en: I played the ace of spades and won the card game.
examples.zh: 我打出黑桃 A，贏了這場牌局。

examples.en: Do you have a spare pen I can borrow?
examples.zh: 你有多的筆可以借我嗎？

examples.en: We keep a spare key under the flowerpot.
examples.zh: 我們把備用鑰匙放在花盆底下。

examples.en: I read novels in my spare time.
examples.zh: 我在空閒時間看小說。

examples.en: Can you spare a few minutes to talk with me?
examples.zh: 你能抽出幾分鐘跟我談談嗎？

examples.en: The teacher spared us extra homework before the holiday.
examples.zh: 假期前老師免了我們額外的作業。

examples.en: Please spare me the details; I only want the result.
examples.zh: 細節就省了吧，我只想知道結果。

examples.en: A spark from the fireplace landed on the carpet.
examples.zh: 壁爐的一點火星掉到了地毯上。

examples.en: The teacher's story was the spark that made me love reading.
examples.zh: 老師的故事點燃了我對閱讀的熱愛。

examples.en: There was no spark between the two actors on the stage.
examples.zh: 這兩位演員在舞台上沒有火花。

examples.en: The speech sparked a lively discussion in class.
examples.zh: 這場演講在班上引發了熱烈的討論。

examples.en: A loose wire can spark and cause trouble.
examples.zh: 鬆脫的電線可能冒出火花而造成危險。

examples.en: The museum visit sparked her interest in history.
examples.zh: 參觀博物館激起了她對歷史的興趣。

examples.en: The museum has an old spear from more than two thousand years ago.
examples.zh: 博物館有一支兩千多年前的古老長矛。

examples.en: In the story, the hero carries a spear and a shield.
examples.zh: 故事中，英雄帶著一支長矛和一面盾牌。

examples.en: Students learned how people made a spear from stone and wood.
examples.zh: 學生們學到了古人如何用石頭和木頭製作長矛。

examples.en: This rare species of bird lives only on the island.
examples.zh: 這種稀有的鳥類只棲息在這座島上。

examples.en: Many species of fish are disappearing from the ocean.
examples.zh: 許多魚類物種正從海洋中消失。

examples.en: Scientists discover a new species of frog almost every year.
examples.zh: 科學家幾乎每年都會發現一種新的青蛙物種。

senses.zh: 精神上的；心靈的；宗教的

examples.en: Many people find spiritual peace in quiet places.
examples.zh: 許多人在安靜的地方找到心靈的平靜。

examples.en: Reading good books is a kind of spiritual food.
examples.zh: 讀好書是一種精神糧食。

examples.en: My grandmother is a spiritual person who visits the temple every week.
examples.zh: 我奶奶是個重視心靈生活的人，每週都去寺廟。

examples.en: We had a splendid view of the mountains from our hotel.
examples.zh: 我們從飯店望出去，山景十分壯麗。

examples.en: That's a splendid idea; let's try it this weekend.
examples.zh: 這個主意太棒了，我們這個週末試試看。

examples.en: The queen wore a splendid gold dress at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 女王在典禮上穿著華麗的金色禮服。

examples.en: Let's split the pizza into eight pieces.
examples.zh: 我們把披薩切成八片吧。

examples.en: The friends split the bill after dinner.
examples.zh: 朋友們飯後分攤了帳單。

examples.en: The old wooden table split in two when we moved it.
examples.zh: 那張舊木桌在我們搬動時裂成了兩半。

examples.en: There is a long split in the wall of the classroom.
examples.zh: 教室的牆上有一道長長的裂縫。

examples.en: The class had a split over where to go on the trip.
examples.zh: 班上對旅行要去哪裡意見分歧。

examples.en: The two brothers agreed on a fifty-fifty split of the money.
examples.zh: 兄弟倆同意把錢對半分。

examples.en: Sprinkle some cheese on the pasta before serving.
examples.zh: 上菜前在義大利麵上撒一些起司。

examples.en: She sprinkled water on the plants every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上都在植物上灑水。

examples.en: Dad sprinkled salt on the eggs and started eating.
examples.zh: 爸爸在蛋上撒了鹽，然後開始吃。

examples.en: He stabbed a fork into the potato to see if it was ready.
examples.zh: 他用叉子戳進馬鈴薯，看看熟了沒有。

examples.en: She stabbed a straw through the lid of her cup.
examples.zh: 她把吸管戳穿杯蓋。

examples.en: Do not stab the pencil into the desk.
examples.zh: 不要把鉛筆戳進桌子裡。

examples.en: You can check the status of your order on our website.
examples.zh: 你可以在我們的網站上查詢訂單的狀態。

examples.en: Her status as a student gives her a discount on tickets.
examples.zh: 她的學生身分讓她買票有折扣。

examples.en: In some jobs, social status is more important than salary.
examples.zh: 在某些工作中，社會地位比薪水更重要。

examples.en: Cut the stem of the rose at an angle.
examples.zh: 把玫瑰的莖斜切。

examples.en: The plant has a thin green stem and large leaves.
examples.zh: 這株植物有細細的綠色莖和大片的葉子。

examples.en: The stem of the word happiness is happy.
examples.zh: happiness 這個字的詞幹是 happy。

examples.en: Her fear of dogs stems from an accident in her childhood.
examples.zh: 她怕狗是源自童年的一次意外。

examples.en: Many of our problems stem from poor communication.
examples.zh: 我們的許多問題都源自溝通不良。

examples.en: The workers used towels to stem the flow of water from the pipe.
examples.zh: 工人們用毛巾阻止水從水管流出。

examples.en: My brother turned up the stereo while he cleaned his room.
examples.zh: 我哥哥打掃房間時把音響開得很大聲。

examples.en: We bought a new stereo for the living room.
examples.zh: 我們為客廳買了一組新音響。

examples.en: The car has a good stereo, so the long trip was fun.
examples.zh: 這輛車的音響很好，所以長途旅行很有趣。

examples.en: She wore black stockings with her school uniform.
examples.zh: 她穿制服時搭配黑色長襪。

examples.en: Children hang a stocking by the fireplace on Christmas Eve.
examples.zh: 孩子們在聖誕夜把長襪掛在壁爐旁。

examples.en: These warm stockings are perfect for cold winter days.
examples.zh: 這些保暖的長襪很適合寒冷的冬天。

examples.en: Swimming can strengthen your arms and legs.
examples.zh: 游泳可以強健你的手臂和雙腿。

examples.en: The two countries want to strengthen their trade relationship.
examples.zh: 這兩個國家想要加強彼此的貿易關係。

examples.en: Regular practice will strengthen your English skills.
examples.zh: 規律的練習會增進你的英文能力。

examples.en: We strive to give every customer the best service.
examples.zh: 我們努力為每位顧客提供最好的服務。

examples.en: She strives for perfect grades in every subject.
examples.zh: 她努力讓每一科都拿到完美的成績。

examples.en: Students should strive to do their best on the exam.
examples.zh: 學生應該在考試中努力發揮最佳表現。

examples.en: My grandfather had a stroke last year, but he is doing better now.
examples.zh: 我爺爺去年中風，不過他現在好多了。

examples.en: Students practice the strokes needed to write Chinese characters correctly.
examples.zh: 學生練習正確書寫中文字所需的筆畫。

examples.en: Butterfly is the hardest swimming stroke for me.
examples.zh: 蝶式是我覺得最難的泳式。

examples.en: She stroked the cat gently, and it began to purr.
examples.zh: 她輕輕撫摸那隻貓，牠就開始呼嚕呼嚕叫。

examples.en: The father stroked his daughter's hair until she fell asleep.
examples.zh: 爸爸輕撫女兒的頭髮，直到她睡著。

examples.en: He stroked his chin while he thought about the question.
examples.zh: 他一邊思考問題，一邊摸著下巴。

examples.en: The museum lets visitors walk through an old submarine.
examples.zh: 博物館讓遊客走進一艘舊潛水艇參觀。

examples.en: A submarine can stay under the sea for many weeks.
examples.zh: 潛水艇可以在水下待上好幾個星期。

examples.en: My little brother built a toy submarine for the science fair.
examples.zh: 我弟弟為科展做了一艘玩具潛水艇。

examples.en: Do you have any suggestions for our class trip?
examples.zh: 你對我們的班遊有什麼建議嗎？

examples.en: I took her suggestion and tried the soup.
examples.zh: 我接受了她的建議，試喝了那碗湯。

examples.en: Please put your suggestions in the box by the door.
examples.zh: 請把你的建議放進門邊的箱子裡。

examples.en: Please summarize the story in three sentences.
examples.zh: 請用三句話總結這個故事。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to summarize the main points of the article.
examples.zh: 老師要我們摘要這篇文章的重點。

examples.en: Let me summarize what we decided at today's meeting.
examples.zh: 讓我總結一下我們在今天會議中的決定。

examples.en: The surgeon spent three hours repairing the injured player's knee.
examples.zh: 外科醫生花了三個小時修復那位受傷球員的膝蓋。

examples.en: My aunt is a famous heart surgeon in Taipei.
examples.zh: 我阿姨是台北一位有名的心臟外科醫生。

examples.en: The surgeon explained the plan to the patient before the operation.
examples.zh: 外科醫生在手術前向病人說明了計畫。

examples.en: He needs surgery on his knee next month.
examples.zh: 他下個月需要接受膝蓋手術。

examples.en: The surgery took four hours, but it went well.
examples.zh: 手術進行了四個小時，但很順利。

examples.en: She wants to study surgery at medical school.
examples.zh: 她想在醫學院學外科。

examples.en: Students must surrender their phones before entering the exam room.
examples.zh: 學生進入考場前必須交出手機。

examples.en: Don't surrender your dream just because the road is hard.
examples.zh: 不要因為路很難走就放棄夢想。

examples.en: The team refused to surrender and kept playing until the last minute.
examples.zh: 那支隊伍不肯放棄，一直比到最後一分鐘。

examples.en: The hotel has quiet and beautiful surroundings.
examples.zh: 這間飯店的四周環境安靜又優美。

examples.en: It takes time to get used to new surroundings.
examples.zh: 適應新環境需要時間。

examples.en: Our class went hiking to learn about the natural surroundings of the lake.
examples.zh: 我們班去健行，認識湖泊周遭的自然環境。

examples.en: The guard noticed a suspicious bag under the bench.
examples.zh: 警衛注意到長椅下有個可疑的包包。

examples.en: I became suspicious when the website asked for my password.
examples.zh: 那個網站要我輸入密碼時，我起了疑心。

examples.en: Her teacher was suspicious about why the homework looked so similar.
examples.zh: 老師對這些作業為何如此相似感到懷疑。

examples.en: The word banana has three syllables.
examples.zh: banana 這個字有三個音節。

examples.en: The stress in this word falls on the second syllable.
examples.zh: 這個字的重音落在第二個音節。

examples.en: Our teacher asked us to clap once for each syllable.
examples.zh: 老師要我們每個音節拍一次手。

senses.zh: 同情的；體諒的；表示支持的

examples.en: The nurse was kind and sympathetic to every patient.
examples.zh: 護理師對每位病人都親切又富有同情心。

examples.en: She gave me a sympathetic smile when I lost the game.
examples.zh: 我輸掉比賽時，她對我投以體諒的微笑。

examples.en: The manager was sympathetic to our request for more time.
examples.zh: 經理對我們提出的延長時間請求表示支持。

examples.en: We sent flowers to show our sympathy to the family.
examples.zh: 我們送花向那個家庭表達慰問之意。

examples.en: I have a lot of sympathy for people who work two jobs.
examples.zh: 我很同情那些同時做兩份工作的人。

examples.en: The students had little sympathy for the plan to cancel the party.
examples.zh: 學生們不太認同取消派對的計畫。

examples.en: She used a systematic method to study for the exam.
examples.zh: 她用有系統的方法準備考試。

examples.en: The team made a systematic check of every classroom.
examples.zh: 團隊對每間教室進行了有系統的檢查。

examples.en: A systematic approach helps us solve problems faster.
examples.zh: 有條理的做法能幫助我們更快解決問題。

examples.en: A technician came to fix the air conditioner this morning.
examples.zh: 今天早上有一位技術人員來修冷氣。

examples.en: My cousin works as a lab technician at a hospital.
examples.zh: 我表哥在一家醫院擔任實驗室技術員。

examples.en: The sound technician checked the microphones before the concert.
examples.zh: 音響技師在演唱會前檢查了麥克風。

examples.en: Technological changes have made our lives more convenient.
examples.zh: 科技的進步讓我們的生活更方便。

examples.en: The school invested in new technological equipment for the classrooms.
examples.zh: 學校投資為教室添購了新的科技設備。

examples.en: Many people worry about the speed of technological development.
examples.zh: 許多人擔心科技發展的速度。

examples.en: We looked at the moon through a telescope.
examples.zh: 我們用望遠鏡觀察月亮。

examples.en: My father bought a telescope for my birthday.
examples.zh: 爸爸買了一支望遠鏡給我當生日禮物。

examples.en: The science club set up a telescope on the school roof.
examples.zh: 科學社在學校屋頂架設了一台望遠鏡。

examples.en: He has a tendency to talk too fast when he is nervous.
examples.zh: 他緊張時有說話太快的傾向。

examples.en: There is a tendency for prices to rise during the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期期間物價有上漲的趨勢。

examples.en: Some children have a tendency to be shy in new places.
examples.zh: 有些孩子到新的地方有害羞的傾向。

examples.en: The room became tense when the teacher announced the test.
examples.zh: 老師宣布考試時，教室裡的氣氛變得緊張。

examples.en: I felt tense before my first job interview.
examples.zh: 第一次面試前，我覺得很緊張。

examples.en: My neck muscles are tense after sitting at the computer all day.
examples.zh: 我整天坐在電腦前，頸部肌肉繃得很緊。

examples.en: The teacher explained the past tense with many examples.
examples.zh: 老師用許多例子說明過去式。

examples.en: In English, the verb changes with the tense.
examples.zh: 在英文裡，動詞會隨時態而變化。

examples.en: Which tense should I use in this sentence?
examples.zh: 這個句子我該用哪一種時態？

examples.en: There was a lot of tension in the room before the results came out.
examples.zh: 成績公布前，房間裡瀰漫著緊張的氣氛。

examples.en: Listening to music helps me release the tension after work.
examples.zh: 聽音樂幫助我在下班後釋放緊繃的情緒。

examples.en: Check the tension of the rope before you start climbing.
examples.zh: 開始攀爬前，先檢查繩子的拉緊程度。

examples.en: The little boy screamed in terror when the lights went out.
examples.zh: 燈熄滅時，小男孩嚇得尖叫。

examples.en: She felt a moment of terror when she lost her way in the dark.
examples.zh: 她在黑暗中迷路時，有一瞬間感到驚恐。

examples.en: The movie filled the children with terror, so they could not sleep.
examples.zh: 這部電影讓孩子們非常驚恐，所以他們睡不著。

examples.en: The theme of this year's school festival is friendship.
examples.zh: 今年校慶的主題是友誼。

examples.en: The main theme of the novel is courage.
examples.zh: 這本小說的主要主題是勇氣。

examples.en: We are planning a birthday party with an ocean theme.
examples.zh: 我們正在籌劃一場以海洋為主題的生日派對。

examples.en: The police made a thorough search of the building.
examples.zh: 警方對這棟大樓進行了徹底的搜查。

examples.en: She gave us a thorough explanation of the rules.
examples.zh: 她向我們詳細說明了規則。

examples.en: Please do a thorough check of your answers before you hand in the test.
examples.zh: 交卷前請仔細檢查你的答案。

examples.en: It was thoughtful of you to bring me an umbrella.
examples.zh: 你帶傘給我，真是體貼。

examples.en: He is a thoughtful boy who always helps his classmates.
examples.zh: 他是個體貼的男孩，總是幫助同學。

examples.en: She gave a thoughtful answer after thinking for a minute.
examples.zh: 她想了一分鐘後，給了一個深思熟慮的回答。

examples.en: My sister tickled my feet until I laughed.
examples.zh: 我姊姊搔我的腳底，搔到我大笑。

examples.en: The feather tickled my nose and made me sneeze.
examples.zh: 羽毛弄得我鼻子發癢，害我打噴嚏。

examples.en: The soft wool sweater tickles my neck.
examples.zh: 這件柔軟的羊毛衣讓我的脖子發癢。

examples.en: Check the bus timetable before you leave home.
examples.zh: 出門前先看一下公車時刻表。

examples.en: Our class timetable has two English lessons on Monday.
examples.zh: 我們的課表週一有兩堂英文課。

examples.en: The train timetable changes during the summer holidays.
examples.zh: 火車時刻表在暑假期間會有變動。

examples.en: The timid puppy hid under the sofa when guests arrived.
examples.zh: 客人來的時候，那隻膽小的小狗躲到沙發底下。

examples.en: She is too timid to speak in front of the class.
examples.zh: 她太膽小，不敢在全班面前說話。

examples.en: A timid student may need more time to answer the question.
examples.zh: 害羞的學生可能需要更多時間回答問題。

examples.en: The weather was hot but tolerable in the shade.
examples.zh: 天氣很熱，但待在陰涼處就還能忍受。

examples.en: The hotel was not great, but the price was tolerable.
examples.zh: 這間飯店不算太好，但價格還算可以接受。

examples.en: After taking some medicine, the pain became tolerable.
examples.zh: 吃了藥之後，疼痛變得可以忍受了。

examples.en: Our teacher teaches us tolerance toward different opinions.
examples.zh: 我們的老師教我們寬容看待不同的意見。

examples.en: The school has zero tolerance for cheating on exams.
examples.zh: 學校對考試作弊零容忍。

examples.en: Some people have a high tolerance for spicy food.
examples.zh: 有些人對辛辣食物的耐受度很高。
